text:
Shayne Gostisbehere is 33 and still the offensive defenseman Carolina wanted when it brought him back. He has 14 points in 19 games, 6 on the power play, and The Hockey News called him a key offensive dynamo. He scored in the 9-2 rout of Chicago, his first goal in this ten-game stretch.

Carolina gets 62% of the expected goals at five on five with him on, but that comes with help. The team has scored 7.3 more goals than expected with him out there, the main reason his point pace looks like a first-pair star's. His own finishing is honest (3 goals on 2.3 expected).

Evolving-Hockey's read from last season is the right frame: 46th of 215 defensemen, driving play at the 86th percentile, with the caveat that his teammates are strong. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking has his primary shot assists in the 82nd percentile among defensemen. He's a setup man on a team that finishes. Watch the assist rate when Carolina's shooting cools: that's where the gap between his process and his points will close.
headline: Gostisbehere is doing what Carolina brought him back for
